risks.risk: Engine/gearbox may not actually be the claimed 2ZR (wrong engine family) or wrong gearbox type.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine code/ID plate (or stamped code on block) and the gearbox model/ID plate, plus a photo of the transmission tag/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified used engine/gearbox bundle with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may require replacement/return).

risks.risk: “Tested and working” may be false or may not hold under real load; internal damage may not be visible when wrapped.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) and a separate video showing gearbox engagement/drive, or a diagnostic scan report showing no major faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as parts/repair risk).

risks.risk: “No knock” may be untrue; knocking can be intermittent and may only show under certain RPM/load.
risks.proof: Video of engine running under load (e.g., revs) with clear audio, or a mechanic’s inspection report confirming no bearing/rod knock.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible knock/unknown noise (worst-case: assume internal wear risk).

risks.risk: “Low mileage” may be inaccurate without ECU/odometer evidence.
risks.proof: Photo of ECU mileage/odometer readout (OBD scan screenshot) or service record showing mileage at removal.

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; resealed/repaired units can look intact from outside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket/seal surfaces, bolt heads, and any tamper marks; also photos of timing cover area (if accessible) and oil pan area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously opened/repair history possible (worst-case: treat as repaired/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk for Corolla 2010: even if engine family is correct, mounts, wiring, starter/alternator, and gearbox bellhousing may differ.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact included parts list (starter, alternator, ECU, wiring harness connectors, mounts, drive shafts if any) and gearbox bellhousing code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs additional parts (worst-case: buyer may pay for missing items).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos (not wrapped) showing the engine code/ID plate (or stamped code on block) and the gearbox model/ID plate/tag.
Send a short running video with clear audio (cold start preferred) showing no knock.
Send a gearbox engagement/drive video (or mechanic’s test report) showing it engages and drives.
Send an ECU/OBD mileage/odometer readout screenshot and any removal/service documents.
Send close-up photos of gasket/seal areas and bolt heads to confirm “never opened.”
Send a detailed list of what is included (ECU, harness, starter, alternator, mounts, etc.) with photos of each included item.
